title: FHIR Clinical CDR Strategy Configuration
description: MongoDB layout, fhir-gen generation, and fhir-mql search settings for native FHIR R5 resources.

database.description: MongoDB database name for FHIR resource collections

schema_version.description: FHIR schema version passed to fhir-gen

collection_prefix.description: Optional prefix for per-resource-type collection names

mode.description: One MongoDB collection per FHIR resource type

denormalize_on_generate.description: Run fhir-mql denormalization after synthetic generation

config_dir.description: Override fhir-mql resource YAML directory; null uses bundled configs

compartment_definitions_dir.description: Override compartment definitions; null uses bundled paths

auto_index.description: After fhir_denormalize, run fhir_ensure_indexes for processed types

seed.description: Default RNG seed for synthetic generation

use_enrichers.description: Apply fhir-gen enrichers when generating resources

recipes.description: Named generation recipes; merged from specification/recipes.json at load time

enabled.description: Add Kehrnel synthetic meta.tag and extension before MongoDB save
